authpolicy: Check user affiliation Implements the authpolicyd part to make sure that the user affiliation flag gets set properly in Chrome. This influences some subsystems, e.g. whether the user can use client certificates stored on the 'system' token (for a full list, ask pmarko@ :-). During user policy fetch, checks whether the user domain is affiliated with the device domain. This is achieved by testing whether the user can query device information (with net ads search), which requires that the device domain trusts the user domain. In the PolicyData, the device affiliation IDs are always set to {"ad_affiliation_marker"}. If the user is affiliated, its user affiliation IDs are also set to {"ad_affiliation_marker"}. Otherwise, they are left empty. In Chrome, a user is considered affiliated if the intersection between the two sets is non-empty. This, this gives the expected result. BUG=chromium:865969 TEST=cros_run_unit_tests --board=amd64-generic --packages authpolicy Change-Id: I9d4cd6f963c04014c67f06b4f5292ff1dc2d9dcd Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1145380 Commit-Ready: Lutz Justen <ljusten@chromium.org> Tested-by: Lutz Justen <ljusten@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Roman Sorokin <rsorokin@chromium.org>

cryptohome: Refactor keyset label logic in HomeDirs Get rid of duplication of keyset label reading/generation logic. Besides the pure refactoring, this also slightly changes the behavior of HomeDirs::GetValidKeyset() to make it consistent with the rest of the code. Previously, when the label passed to this method is of form "legacy-NNN", then this method could proceed with a keyset with the index NNN regardless of whether the keyset has an explicitly set label. After this change, it would only do that if the keyset doesn't have the label explicitly set. It's presumably a safe change, as cryptohome itself always gives back the explicit label whenever it's present in the keyset, and as no caller of cryptohome should make up legacy labels on its own. BUG=none TEST=existing tests Change-Id: I83d46708a4bcb37187470d622535dfe11a4d1075 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1160654 Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ryo Hashimoto <hashimoto@chromium.org>
